dimensions.composition_layout: Horizontal banner strip centered on a solid black background

branding_bottom_right.separator: Vertical thin line with an airplane arrow pointing up
branding_bottom_right.position: Bottom right corner of the canvas

art_style.line_work: Intricate cross-hatching, sharp ink outlines, charcoal texture overlays

color_scheme.base: Monochromatic dark gray and rich black ink tones (Gotham City foundation)
color_scheme.accent_style: Vibrant color splashes popping out of the grayscale base

lighting_and_atmosphere.time_of_day: Golden hour during a hot summer dusk
lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting_type: Dramatic backlighting (rim light) from a warm setting sun

light_sources.sun: Positioned low behind the skyscrapers, casting warm golden-orange volumetric rays
light_sources.street_level: Cool blue neon reflections bounce from wet pavement below

lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: A mix of summer humidity and Gotham haze, warm air distortion visible between building silhouettes

camera_setup.viewpoint: Extreme low-angle shot looking straight up at the sky
camera_setup.lens: 24mm wide-angle lens to exaggerate skyscraper heights and skate jump heights
camera_setup.depth_of_field: Focal point locked on the skateboard deck; background buildings have a progressive soft blur

anatomy.expression: Intense concentration, confident look, slight smirk
anatomy.hair: Dark brown, short messy strands escaping from under the cap
anatomy.pose: Dynamic mid-air skate trick (ollie/kickflip grab), legs bent, torso leaning forward

top.texture: Fine vertical ribbing, subtle sweat highlights on fabric creases

bottom.details: Double stitching, deep side pockets, heavyweight canvas texture

deck.material: 7-ply Canadian maple wood texture, visible scratches on tail and nose

graphic.details: White distressed ink, containing pilares words: 'ATITUDE - VALORIZAÇÃO - AMIZADE' surrounding the central AVA typography

architecture.style: Gotham City-inspired Art Deco and Gothic industrial skyscraper spires
elements: Distant building rooftops decorated with water tanks and steel antennas
Iron fire escapes zigzagging down building facades in sharp perspective
Deep concrete alleys with heavy vertical shadow casting

graffiti_details.concept: Vibrant, fresh street art painted onto building bricks and concrete panels
designs: Abstract graffiti shapes behind the skater
AVA lettering tag hidden in urban style on the left building wall
Street art characters drawn on structural columns
